evidence: Carries the 'Build system' label and directly modifies Guix build manifests, patches, and verification scripts in contrib/guix/.
rationale: Switching official Linux release binaries to `-static-pie` delivers a substantial portability improvement across Linux environments. It allows release binaries to execute without custom shims on non-glibc distributions like Alpine and NixOS as well as systems running older glibc versions, while also facilitating future security hardening like aarch64 pointer authentication (#19075).
